mapper.select: INSERT INTO weight_records ( user_id, record_date, weight_kg, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{recordDate}, #{weightKg}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, record_date) DO UPDATE SET weight_kg = EXCLUDED.weight_kg, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id, user_id, record_date, weight_kg, created_at, updated_at
SELECT id, user_id, record_date, weight_kg, created_at, updated_at FROM weight_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record_date ASC
SELECT id, user_id, record_date, weight_kg, created_at, updated_at FROM weight_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record_date DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
